items.question: How do I avoid getting too many low-value alerts?
items.answer: Set like thresholds, time windows, and keyword conditions per account. Start narrow, then expand — this keeps alert quality high from day one.

items.question: Can it detect old posts that suddenly go viral again?
items.answer: Yes. The system compares current engagement against historical records and flags abnormal growth, helping you spot 'second-wave' viral content.

items.question: Can I monitor my own account for performance tracking?
items.answer: Yes. Add your own account to the watchlist — compare your performance against competitors using the same metrics and rules.

items.question: How do monitoring results integrate with team workflows?
items.answer: Matched content syncs automatically to Lark Base. Your ops, content, and strategy teams can annotate, assign tasks, and run retrospectives on the same shared dataset.
